name: feishu_unread_digest
description: 飞书未读消息分类汇总 (Feishu unread digest): collect every unread message across your chats via the bundled `lark-cli`, bucket them by what they ask of you (mention / action / question / decision / info), and emit a short ranked digest. Two nodes: `collect` runs websites/feishu.com/plugin/collect.sh (exec, so policy.allow_exec is required), `classify` runs the Rhai plugin websites/feishu.com/plugin/classify.rhai which does the routing, and a choice node judges whether anything actually needs a reply. Reads only - it never sends, marks read, or reacts. Needs lark-cli on PATH plus `lark-cli auth login`; a stale user token makes the collector report ok:false rather than an empty digest. Both knobs are optional: an unset chats_limit/page_size expands to the empty string and collect.sh falls back to 15 chats / 20 messages.

collected_ok.instructions: Did the Feishu unread collection succeed? Answer no if stdout carries ok:false, if exit_code is non-zero, or if stdout is not the collector's JSON - a stale lark-cli token and a network failure both look like this.

criteria.A: yes: stdout is the collector's JSON with ok:true
criteria.B: no: the collection failed or returned nothing usable

classified.instructions: Did the unread messages classify into buckets without error?

criteria.A: yes: buckets and digest are present

needs_reply.instructions: Reading the classified unread digest above, does anything need the user's reply right now? Weight the buckets in this order: mention first, then action and question, then decision. 'info' alone is not worth interrupting anyone.

criteria.A: no: nothing in the digest needs a reply now
criteria.B: yes: at least one message is waiting on the user
